dataset_name: Synthetic Resume–Job Description Grouped Matching Benchmark
description: Curated synthetic benchmark designed for within-job ranking evaluation and extraction validation. Contains 5 distinct job descriptions with 5 candidate resumes per job (25 candidate–job pairs total), enabling valid within-group ranking analysis.
disclaimer: Academic benchmark fixture: All candidate profiles, resumes, and job descriptions are synthetic software artifacts. Engineered solely to evaluate ranking metrics, edge cases, and algorithmic behaviors under controlled conditions; does not represent empirical real-world candidate distribution or validated hiring outcomes.

annotator_metadata.inter_annotator_agreement: N/A (Single-annotator limitation disclosed; no multi-annotator agreement claimed)

relevance_scale.0: Irrelevant / Disjoint / Degenerate: Unrelated domain, missing core requirements entirely, or empty/malformed text.
relevance_scale.1: Weakly Relevant / Minimal Match: Tangential overlap or surface words only; candidate focus is in an unrelated area.
relevance_scale.2: Moderately Relevant / Partial Match: Demonstrates related technical foundations and several required skills, but lacks key core requirements.
relevance_scale.3: Highly Relevant / Strong Match: Substantial technical alignment with primary required stack, relevant project/work experiences, and domain context.
